identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to enumerate running processes on a Windows endpoint, which triggers the Suspicious PowerShell Enumeration of Running Processes alert. Cortex should detect the use of Get-Process in a PowerShell context.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Enumeration of Running Processes
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell commands that enumerate running processes using Get-Process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Get-Process'

abiocs.name: PowerShell Process Enumeration Behavior

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Process Enumeration Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Get-Process'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_command_line
